description: Shorts-pipeline daily.yml + third.yml red since 2026-08-14: nobody authors the day's packages. run_trending_daily refuses with 'validated production manifest is incomplete: found 0/6 packages in state/trending_packages/<date>' — the fail-closed gate working correctly on an upstream authoring outage (the Routine and the ChatGPT takeover are both producing nothing).
